old: Self-hypnosis can become very powerful during loveyhuasca, meditation, lucid dreaming, grief, sexual energy, prayer, sleep loss, or other plant-medicine-adjacent states. Sometimes the mind opens faster than the adult self can organize what is arriving.
new: Self-hypnosis can be quite powerful when doing loveyhuasca, meditation, lucid dreaming, grieving, working with sexual energy, praying, not sleeping well, or doing a lot of the things people do around plant medicine work. Sometimes, people open up too fast for their adult self to make sense of what’s going on.

old: Intensity then gets mistaken for meaning. Sometimes the inner child is finally speaking. Sometimes a Protector is showing fear, or shame, grief, anger, longing, and other buried material are asking for care. But an intense state can also be bodily overload, environmental chaos, sleep deprivation, or plain confusion. A frightening image isn’t automatically truth, a bad feeling isn’t automatically a lesson, and a “download” doesn’t deserve belief merely because it came with excellent lighting.
new: Sometimes it’s intensity, and that’s all it is. Sometimes it’s an inner child emerging. Sometimes it’s a Protector letting someone know they’re scared. Sometimes it’s shame, grief, anger, longing, or a host of other things coming up. Sometimes it’s the body experiencing too much going on inside. Sometimes it’s too much going on outside. Sometimes it’s lack of sleep, or a lack of ability to make sense of what’s going on. Sometimes it’s none of the above. Regardless, unless it’s a clear as day message, just because something came in a certain light, that doesn’t mean it’s true. Just because something felt bad, that doesn’t mean it’s true or helpful. Just because it felt like a “download”, that doesn’t mean it’s true.

old: Before trying to interpret the state, ask a simpler question:
new: Ask yourself some questions to help discern what’s actually true:

old: This guide doesn’t tell anyone to use substances. It does acknowledge that many people first encounter self-hypnosis, inner-child contact, or Higher Self dialogue while altered.
new: This is NOT to say that you SHOULD do it, but many people have used substances in order to do self-hypnosis, contact their inner child, or talk to their Higher Self.

old: Do not use altered states to force revelation. Use them to deepen listening, strengthen love, and improve ordinary life.
new: Do not do it to try to FORCE yourself to get to a certain revelation about yourself, but rather to help yourself become more in tune with love and helping you better your life.

old: A past opening can be a resource without becoming a state you must reproduce. Having experienced love once, being able to access it only in a particular state, and contacting it reliably in daily life are different things. Let the experience widen what seems possible while you build usable access. If the child cannot receive it, meet the difficulty rather than escalating the intensity.
new: For a lot of people, substances helped them to OPEN themselves up to something at one point in their life. If you've had a similar experience, know that there is a difference between you having experienced it at one point, and only being able to access it in a certain state, compared to being able to get to it at any point in your life. Let that experience inform what you OPEN yourself up to. (If you can't give it to the child, try to deal with why you can't, instead of trying to ramp up the experience).

old: During or after an altered state, these prompts are usually more useful than demanding a revelation:
new: Use your altered state of consciousness, either while you're in it or after, to help yourself by asking things like:

old: “Help me stay grounded.” “Help me receive only what I can integrate.” “Help me remember love.” “Help me return when it is time.” “Help me translate this into one ordinary-life change.”
new: Help me to become more grounded. Help me to only take what I can integrate. Help me to remember what it is like to be in love. Help me to come back when it's time. Help me to figure out how to change one thing in my life to make it better.

old: Don’t use self-hypnosis to prolong an altered state indefinitely, recover memories, intensify fear, bypass sleep, override medical needs, or make yourself less able to communicate.
new: DO NOT use self-hypnosis while you are in an altered state of consciousness to try to keep the altered state of consciousness going indefinitely, to try to remember things, to make yourself MORE afraid, to help you not need to sleep, to help you not need to take care of medical problems, to help you become LESS communicative, etc.

old: If the state makes you less loving, less grounded, less honest, less able to sleep, less able to communicate, or less able to meet ordinary responsibilities, stop deepening and start integrating.
new: In other words, if using self-hypnosis while you're in an altered state of consciousness is NOT helping you become MORE loving, MORE grounded, MORE honest with yourself, helps you need SLEEP, become MORE communicative, etc, then stop trying to go DEEPER into your altered state of consciousness, and start working on integrating what you've already gotten from it.

old: Self-hypnosis can become very powerful during loveyhuasca, meditation, lucid dreaming, grief, sexual energy, prayer, sleep loss, or other plant-medicine-adjacent states. Sometimes the mind opens faster than the adult self can organize what is arriving.
new: Self-hypnosis can be POWERFUL when you are in an altered state of consciousness (i.e. when you're loveyhuasca, meditating, have a lucid dream, are dealing with grief, are dealing with sexual energy, are praying, haven't slept, etc, etc, etc around plant medicine). Sometimes you may OPEN yourself up to things FASTER than you are able to put it into context with your adult self.

old: Intensity then gets mistaken for meaning. Sometimes the inner child is finally speaking. Sometimes a Protector is showing fear, or shame, grief, anger, longing, and other buried material are asking for care. But an intense state can also be bodily overload, environmental chaos, sleep deprivation, or plain confusion. A frightening image isn’t automatically truth, a bad feeling isn’t automatically a lesson, and a “download” doesn’t deserve belief merely because it came with excellent lighting.
new: So what you think may be an altered state of consciousness that's meaningful, may not actually be meaningful - it could be your inner child, it could be a Protector, it could be all of the things you're ashamed of / sad about / angry about / etc, coming out to be dealt with. Or it could be that your body is overloaded, your environment is chaotic, you haven't slept enough, etc, etc, etc. Regardless of the lighting that came with the "download", regardless of how "bad" you feel, it doesn't necessarily mean what you think it does!
